messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-gateway-prod` (us-west1) — 5xx error rate > 10% over 3m. PD: P1. AlertID: PD12345 https://pd.internal/pd/PD12345

pagerduty: Triggered: inference-gateway-prod / 5xx-rate (threshold breach). Assigned to: alice

alice: ack — I'm taking this.

bob: I'm on-call SRE (backup). What's the current customer impact? any widespread user-facing failures?

alice: Grafana snapshot: 5xx rate ramped from 0.8% -> 12% in ~6m. Errors primarily 502s. Latency (p50/p95) unchanged. Logs show repeated `upstream reset by peer` from model-serving backend.

dana: tagging runbook: https://runbooks.internal/inference/5xx — recommended steps: check pod evictions, scale gateway pool, inspect recent rollouts.

alice: scaling gateway: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=6`
`kubectl get pods -n prod` -> creating 2 new pods (Pending -> Running). Also enabling fallback routing to eu-west1 for 10% traffic.

carlos: FYI there was a small canary rollout earlier today (model-serving v2.1.3) that updated sidecar proxy config on ~15% of nodes. Could be correlated.

erin: quick smoke: `curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` -> `HTTP/1.1 502` with body `{"error":"upstream write failed"}` — consistent with upstream resets.

bob: Can we isolate canary pods and cut traffic to them? If it's config-related, rollback might be faster than chasing root cause.

alice: isolating canary now: `kubectl label pod -l rollout=canary traffic=off -n prod` 
Also reweighted routing: stable -> 100, canary -> 0 using routing service.

incidentbot: Update: 5xx rate dropped to 3.2% (1m). Pager acknowledged by alice.

bob: :thumbsup: keep monitoring for 15m. If stable, escalate to postmortem and close page.

alice: created INC-2026-042 in ops with notes: suspected canary sidecar + upstream resets; mitigation applied (scale + route reweight + isolate canary). Handing to carlos for postmortem lead.

carlos: I'll own the postmortem. Please preserve pod logs, traces and sample requests (timestamps noted). If 5xx spikes back, I'll escalate to on-call manager.

dana: customer impact: support flagged ~120 failed requests across ~8 customers; transient errors, retries succeeded for most. No major SLA breach reported yet. Support looped in.

alice: closing pager in PD — setting status to "monitoring" and moving to post-incident review. Will update INC-2026-042 after traces are analyzed.

pagerduty: Pager closed by alice (incident acknowledged -> resolved state updated) at 1712005908.

erin: saved sample failing request + headers to the ticket.

alice: thanks all — keep an eye on any regression during the next deploy window.
